name: Zene
author: lunedusk
description: Zene Discord framework (Node 20+, pure ESM). Install clones the repo, installs locked dependencies, builds when src/ is present (failures abort install), and starts via node --import ./core/dependency/index.mjs. AUTO_UPDATE is panel git-pull only and is independent of Zene AutoUpdater.
startup:
set -euo pipefail
if [[ -d .git ]] && [[ "${AUTO_UPDATE:-0}" == "1" ]]; then git pull --ff-only; fi
if [[ -n "${NODE_PACKAGES:-}" ]]; then /usr/local/bin/npm install --no-save ${NODE_PACKAGES}; fi
if [[ -n "${UNNODE_PACKAGES:-}" ]]; then /usr/local/bin/npm uninstall ${UNNODE_PACKAGES}; fi
if [[ ! -f /home/container/core/dependency/index.mjs ]]; then
  if [[ -f /home/container/package.json ]]; then
    /usr/local/bin/npm ci || /usr/local/bin/npm install
    if [[ -d /home/container/src ]]; then /usr/local/bin/npm run slim-build; fi
  fi
fi
if [[ ! -f /home/container/core/dependency/index.mjs ]]; then
  echo "ERROR: compiled Core entry core/dependency/index.mjs is missing after install/build."
  exit 1
fi

# Production UI gate: DashboardMode=true requires a built SPA (never Vite in panel production).
DM="$(echo "${DashboardMode:-auto}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
if [[ "$DM" == "true" ]]; then
  if [[ ! -f /home/container/apps/web/dist/index.html ]]; then
    echo "ERROR: DashboardMode=true but apps/web/dist/index.html is missing. Rebuild UI or set DashboardMode=false."
    exit 1
  fi
  if [[ ! -f /home/container/apps/web/scripts/dashboard-host.mjs ]]; then
    echo "ERROR: DashboardMode=true but apps/web/scripts/dashboard-host.mjs is missing."
    exit 1
  fi
fi
if [[ "${NODE_ENV:-}" == "development" ]]; then
  echo "WARNING: NODE_ENV=development enables Vite for the dashboard child; production panels should leave NODE_ENV unset or production."
fi

exec /usr/local/bin/node --import ./core/dependency/index.mjs "/home/container/${MAIN_FILE}" ${NODE_ARGS:-}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git curl jq ca-certificates python3 make g++
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ "${USER_UPLOAD:-0}" = "true" ] || [ "${USER_UPLOAD:-0}" = "1" ]; then
  echo "user_upload mode — skipping git clone"
  exit 0
fi

GIT_ADDRESS="${GIT_ADDRESS:-}"
if [ -z "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: GIT_ADDRESS is required"
  exit 1
fi
if [[ "${GIT_ADDRESS}" != *.git ]]; then
  GIT_ADDRESS="${GIT_ADDRESS}.git"
fi

BRANCH="${GIT_BRANCH:-main}"

# Clone without embedding credentials into the persisted remote URL.
if [ -n "${ACCESS_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
  AUTH_HEADER="Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
  if [ -n "${USERNAME:-}" ]; then
    AUTH_HEADER="Authorization: Basic $(printf '%s:%s' "${USERNAME}" "${ACCESS_TOKEN}" | base64 | tr -d '\n')"
  fi
  git -c http.extraHeader="${AUTH_HEADER}" clone --branch "${BRANCH}" --single-branch "${GIT_ADDRESS}" .
  git remote set-url origin "${GIT_ADDRESS}"
else
  git clone --branch "${BRANCH}" --single-branch "${GIT_ADDRESS}" .
fi

if [ -f package.json ]; then
  if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
    npm ci
  else
    npm install
  fi
  if [ -d src ]; then
    npm run slim-build
  fi
  if [ -d apps/web ] && [ -f apps/web/package.json ]; then
    echo "Building dashboard UI (apps/web)..."
    (cd apps/web && npm ci && npm run build)
    if [ ! -f apps/web/dist/index.html ]; then
      echo "ERROR: apps/web/dist/index.html missing after dashboard build."
      exit 1
    fi
  fi
fi

if [ ! -f core/dependency/index.mjs ] && [ ! -f index.js ]; then
  echo "ERROR: install finished without a runnable Core artifact"
  exit 1
fi

echo "Zene install complete"

variables.name: Git Repository Address
variables.description: HTTPS Git URL for the Zene repository (credentials are not written into the remote URL).

variables.name: Auto Update (git pull)
variables.description: When 1, run git pull --ff-only on each start. Independent of Zene AutoUpdater env.

variables.name: Dashboard Mode
variables.description: Separate dashboard process: auto (start when apps/web available), true (required), false (off). Core API stays on APIPort.

variables.name: Additional Node packages
variables.description: Extra packages installed on start (space-separated). Prefer baking deps into the image/repo.

variables.name: Git Username
variables.description: Optional username for private clone (used only during install; not stored in remote URL).

variables.name: Git Access Token
variables.description: Optional PAT for private clone (used only during install; not stored in remote URL).

variables.name: Node arguments
variables.description: Extra arguments after the entry file. ESM loader is applied automatically.

variables.name: Dashboard Port
variables.description: Port for the separate Vite/dashboard-host process (Core uses APIPort).
